# Diptos — Condition-Verified USDC Settlement & AI Agent Guardrails

> Non-custodial programmable USDC escrow links, continuous Time-Entropic Collateral Decay (TECD) late-delivery rebates, and proof-gated HTTP 402 (x402) AI agent budgets.

## Surfaces
- Apex Site: https://diptos.xyz
- Escrow Engine: https://app.diptos.xyz
- AI Agent Sandbox (Dipto): https://agent.diptos.xyz
- Developer Documentation: https://sdk.diptos.xyz
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Jayram2204/Diptos-Arc

## Live Contracts — Arc Testnet (Chain ID: 5042002)
- RPC: https://rpc.testnet.arc.network
- Explorer: https://testnet.arcscan.app
- DiptosEscrow.sol: 0x601bD8caDf9ba2274E645412C1Fca2dF13a318F5 (18-dec Native USDC, non-custodial, unaudited testnet · 34/34 Foundry tests)
- DiptosRegistry.sol: 0xC831EBFA825d88853625C52d1BD55c456111B004 (canonical keccak256 commitment ledger)
- ArcUSDC Precompile: 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000

## Packages & Quickstart
- Core SDK: `@diptos/sdk` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/@diptos/sdk)
  Install: `pnpm add @diptos/sdk viem`
- AI Agent Guardrails: `@diptos/agent-guard` (x402 conditional verification + per-agent USDC budget caps)

### Minimal TypeScript Example (Arc Testnet 5042002)
```ts
import { DiptosClient } from '@diptos/sdk'
import { keccak256, toHex } from 'viem'

const diptos = new DiptosClient({
  rpcUrl: 'https://rpc.testnet.arc.network',
  apiBaseUrl: 'https://diptos.xyz',
  escrowContract: '0x601bD8caDf9ba2274E645412C1Fca2dF13a318F5',
  registryContract: '0xC831EBFA825d88853625C52d1BD55c456111B004',
})

const escrowId = keccak256(toHex('diptos:arc:5042002:task-001'))
const tx = diptos.buildFundEscrowTx({
  escrowId,
  payee: '0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD',
  amountUsdc: 250,
  deadlineUnix: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 86_400,
  lambdaBps: 5000, // λ = 0.50
  isAgentMode: false,
})
```

## Security & Trust Model
- Zero platform custody: Diptos never holds user private keys or sweep permissions over escrowed principal.
- Permissionless recovery: Payers can always call `claimTimeoutRefund(escrowId)` after `deadline + gracePeriod`.
- Admin safeguards: `revokeOracleSigner()` kill-switch and configurable 1-hour outflow velocity circuit breaker on oracle-triggered releases.
- Zero-dust invariant: `payeePayout + buyerRebate + protocolFee == principal` across both 18-dec Arc Native USDC and 6-dec Base ERC-20 USDC.
